datasets.title: Interferogram of Magnitude 6.5 Earthquake in Leyte, Philippines (July 07, 2017)
datasets.description: A radar interferogram of the Magnitude 6.5 earthquake that hit Ormoc City Leyte last 6 July 2017. Data were processed using 2 Sentinel C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar data (Repeat Pass). [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/leytemagnitude6-5earthquake06072017]

lineage.description: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR data from repeat-pass acquisitions were processed using radar interferometry techniques to generate interferograms depicting ground displacement patterns from the magnitude 6.5 earthquake that occurred on 6 July 2017 in Ormoc City, Leyte. The resulting KMZ files represent the processed interferometric phase and coherence information.

sources.name: Sentinel-1 C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar
sources.description: European Space Agency satellite radar data used to generate interferograms measuring ground surface displacement from the earthquake event
